catalog.title: UI catalog
catalog.heading: User interface catalog
catalog.intro: The app’s own components, mounted on a fake profile whose every item comes from the manifest. Actions triggered here stay queued: none is sent to Bungie.

notes.foundations: Theme and effects are the app’s real settings: changing them here changes them everywhere.
notes.icons: components/icons — inline SVG, color follows the text.
notes.controls: View tabs, category tabs and sorting write to the real settings; the other controls only hold local state.
notes.items: Click: pinned tooltip. Double-click: equip (queued). Drag: move (queued).
notes.tooltips: Item tooltips, laid flat. In context they open in a Floating UI portal (or as a bottom sheet on phones).
notes.loadouts: Loadout gestures (equip, overwrite, rename) go to the action queue.
notes.groups: Mounted on local data: the groups view itself writes to the database-synced store, so it has no place here.
notes.actions: These actions are fake and will never run; the original queue is restored when leaving the page.
